latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of full-lp-workflow: a comprehensive, end-to-end LP automation skill.

- Scans top LP opportunities, designs a strategy, assesses risk, executes swaps, and enters the LP position—all in one pipeline.
- Requires minimal user input (mainly capital amount) and pauses for user confirmation before swaps and position entry.
- Provides detailed reporting on portfolio impact after LP entry.
- Automatically handles token swaps if needed, with clear user approval steps.
- Robust error handling and recovery suggestions at each stage.
- Do not use when user already knows the specific pool or only wants strategy comparison.
